_readme.description: Manual mapping file for quest rewards that cannot be automatically matched
_readme.format: Map reward script names from GdsQuestRewards.lua to quest IDs
_readme.usage: Add entries in the format: 'RewardScriptName': quest_id
_readme.platforms: Organize by platform (P63, P7, P1, etc.) to match game structure
_readme.how_to_find_quest_ids: Check the database or CFF editor to find quest IDs for each platform

_notes.matching_strategy: When this file contains a mapping, it takes precedence over automatic matching
_notes.null_values: null values mean 'not yet mapped' - fill in quest IDs as you identify them
workflow: 1. Extract all reward names from GdsQuestRewards.lua
2. Match quest IDs by playing the game or examining quest descriptions
3. Fill in the quest_id for each reward name
4. The parser will use these manual mappings when loading quest data
_notes.benefits: Manual mapping ensures 100% accurate reward data for all quests
_notes.multi_language: Consider adding English/German quest name hints to make mapping easier
